**In one line**: A report says some Anthropic investors expect an IPO valuing the company around $2 trillion, reigniting debate over stretched AI valuations.

### Key points
- According to The Globe and Mail, some Anthropic investors reportedly anticipate a public listing valuing the company near $2 trillion.
- The article frames this against a recent record-setting IPO that, per the report, has delivered virtually no returns to early buyers within two months.
- No confirmed IPO timeline or terms are cited; the piece reads as reporting on investor expectations rather than a formal filing.

### Why it matters
A $2 trillion valuation would rival today's largest tech companies and, if realized, would reset the benchmark for AI-company valuations. Yet the cited underperformance of a recent large IPO serves as a caution that lofty expectations can diverge sharply from actual market returns.
